credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/pitcher.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. REARING: one lime trumpet rises off a moss tussock and leans its hooded mouth at the foe, a small one behind. Gesture: the lid lifts, peeks open wide with nectar glinting on the lip, then claps shut. Two hues: the vein maroon is the dark slot (veins, the mouth, the lime's shade); the hood is the shared white (a genuinely white part). Sport: the anthocyanin-free green form.
